name: Forged Censer Warrants
summary: The Hollow Mile's best-selling document: forged Censer seizure and passage warrants, good enough to fool every watch-house on Aurelith and most junior wardens. The Mile's forgers work from genuine templates captured over eight centuries of raids; the best — 'Ledger-grade' — have passed inspection at the archive-quarter itself. A warrant is the only legal fiction that opens Censer doors, which makes it the black market's crown export.
origin: ~200 Si onward; craft refined through every purge since
current_whereabouts: Wherever prohibition meets commerce: caravans, expeditions, rescue attempts, and one in every three smuggling holds.
properties: Grades run from watch-house-passable to Ledger-grade (archive-quarter-passable)
Genuine warrants carry a cinder-press mark from the oath-vault; Ledger-grade forgeries replicate the smell
Possession is presumptive evidence of intent — unless you are using it, in which case it is evidence of nothing at all
keepers: The Mile's forger-cells; the Ledger takes its cut. The Censer's anti-forgery office employs more analysts than any other division — and buys forgeries discreetly to study them.
value_or_danger: Watch-house grade: a month's wages. Ledger-grade: a fortune, or a noose.
adventure_hooks: A forged warrant players used turns out to be real — issued by someone inside the order who wants deniable agents.
The Mile commissions players to recover a seized forgery-template before Censer analysts crack it.
A client's warrant fails at the worst moment; tracing the bad batch leads up the Mile's chain toward the Ledger itself.

rarity.note: Manufactured class, not single pieces; Ledger-grade passes anything.
